tur: First-person survival diaries: 30 days trapped in one place (stick-figure animation)
ozet: Narrator Sam is trapped inside a shopping mall after the doors lock. Each film follows a day-by-day diary of staying calm, finding allies and solving problems. Tense but bloodless: no gore, no deaths shown.
kurallar: Fictional story only; no real people, brands or real events.
No blood, no violence; tension comes from darkness, noises, hunger and tough choices.
Natural English, short sentences, first person, one idea per scene.
yazim: Long episode: cold open, four parts with cards, a cliffhanger ending.

sam.kim: Narrator, a regular guy in a red hoodie trapped in the mall.

mia.kim: Quick-thinking shop employee who knows the building.
